comment: Shared EBOOT id table (one entry per build): title_id, region, app_ver, size and sha256 of the decrypted EBOOT, status, self_sha256 of the disc's encrypted EBOOT.BIN, segment_sha256 of the loaded segments. Toro adds status 'unsupported' (refused: the port is built from one build only), self_size, title, entry and text_size. Hashes, sizes and ids only, read from the maintainer's own discs. Checked by tools/release/eboot_ids.py.
